SourceFile
  RootPackage
  public struct Pair
    field number: Int
    field text: String
  public enum Choice
    Number(Int)
    Text(String)
  class IntGate(var waiter: Continuation<Int>?)
    fun complete
  class PairGate(var waiter: Continuation<Pair>?)
    fun complete
  class BooleanGate(var waiter: Continuation<Boolean>?)
    fun complete
  class ChoiceGate(var waiter: Continuation<Choice>?)
    fun complete
  class IntRegistration(val gate: IntGate), SuspendRegistration<Int>
    public fun register
  class PairRegistration(val gate: PairGate), SuspendRegistration<Pair>
    public fun register
  class BooleanRegistration(val gate: BooleanGate), SuspendRegistration<Boolean>
    public fun register
  class ChoiceRegistration(val gate: ChoiceGate), SuspendRegistration<Choice>
    public fun register
  suspend fun awaitTop<T>(registration: SuspendRegistration<T>): T
    =
      Call suspendCoroutine
        Var registration
  class Awaiter()
    suspend fun awaitMember
  class GenericTask(val intGate: IntGate, val pairGate: PairGate, val booleanGate: BooleanGate, val choiceGate: ChoiceGate), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class RecordingCompletion(), Continuation<Int>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException
  fun main()
    val intGate
      Call IntGate
        Var None
    val pairGate
      Call PairGate
        Var None
    val booleanGate
      Call BooleanGate
        Var None
    val choiceGate
      Call ChoiceGate
        Var None
    Call startCoroutine
      Call GenericTask
        Var intGate
        Var pairGate
        Var booleanGate
        Var choiceGate
      Call RecordingCompletion
    Call println
      StringLiteral "started"
    MethodCall complete
      Var intGate
      IntLiteral 10
    MethodCall complete
      Var pairGate
      Call Pair
        IntLiteral 20
        StringLiteral "pair"
    MethodCall complete
      Var booleanGate
      BoolLiteral true
    MethodCall complete
      Var choiceGate
      MethodCall Number
        Var Choice
        IntLiteral 12
